section_summary.extract_value: This Discussion section presents findings from a single study examining the psychometric properties of the Breast Size Rating Scale (BSRS) in Brazilian university women. The study found that BSRS scores have adequate convergent validity and test-retest reliability, with 79.4% of participants dissatisfied with their breast size and 65.5% desiring larger breasts—notably higher than comparable rates in previous research. The authors acknowledge limitations including the single-region sample and lack of discriminant/predictive validity measures, while highlighting the potential utility of the BSRS in Portuguese for future research on breast size dissatisfaction in Brazilian women.
